cases.prompt: An agent to-do asks it to prepare a `person` knowledge page from two attached sources.
cases.expected: Loads `office-library-conventions`; reads the template and the attached sources, and prepares the page as a task artifact.

cases.prompt: The user opens an office session and asks what is waiting on them.
cases.expected: Does not load `office-library-conventions`; loads `office-orchestrator`, which starts from `office.session-brief`.

cases.prompt: Prepare a proposed page for a person who appears in one source, citing it, with the person's email in the source text.
cases.expected: Follows the template's required sections with cited content; puts the email only in a `contact` ref, never in the body; writes the page under `$ORBIT_SCRATCH_DIR` and attaches it with `orbit.task.artifact.put`; writes nothing under `library/`.
